dataSource.notes:
Full nutrition table scraped from the official Panda Express (US) nutrition information page on 2026-07-02. Serving sizes are the standard adult portions as listed by Panda Express (side portion for sides, entree portion for entrees); portion weights in oz come directly from the source's 'Portion (oz)' column. Kids/'cub meal' portion variants, pre-configured Cub Meals, beverages, soups, fortune cookie, and apple crisps were excluded. All calorie/protein/carb/fat values are copied verbatim from the official table; no values were estimated.

DRINKS ADDED 2026-08-10 from the same first-party nutrition table as the food. 102 items across 25 sized groups at Kids 12 / Small 22 / Medium 30 / Large 42 fl oz; the teas pour 22/32/40, so fluid ounces are stored per item rather than inferred from the size label. Small is the default pour. Panda's own table contains the typo 'sprite - meddium', normalised here. A full re-diff of all 36 pre-existing items against the 178 published rows found ZERO macro mismatches; only the appetizer serving lines changed, to carry the published piece counts.

OMITTED DELIBERATELY: the region-locked duplicates (Fanta Orange 'PR only', Fanta Strawberry 'TX only'), which already exist nationally with different macros — two identically-named rows is worse than one. Also Hot & Sour Soup: its macros and allergens are published, but nothing states whether the broth is meat-based, and hot & sour soup usually is. Shipping dietaryMarkers: [] would assert 'verified free of meat' on a guess.
